comment: Field inspection team dispatched at 10:45 AM today. Water samples collected for GC-MS lab testing. Booms deployed to restrict plume.
I can confirm the foam has subsided slightly near the weir, but the chemical smell is still noticeable around the jogging trail.
This is the third time this month foam has peaked after midnight factory discharge. We need permanent continuous dissolved oxygen sensors here.
Incident successfully addressed. BMC skimmers collected and safely transported the plastics to recycling depot #4. Status marked as Resolved.
Field test comment: Water sample dispatched to analytical laboratory.
